digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store baseline serialization
propositions: Baseline description, status, and priority fields should be stored as normalized scalars (description as text, status/priority as Jira name strings) rather than vendor dicts to reduce serialized size by approximately 66%
The projection must preserve assignee as a raw vendor dict with all identity forms unchanged to maintain inbound suppression semantics and prevent overwrites of concurrent remote edits
Dict-shaped and scalar-equivalent baselines must produce identical compute_update_fields verdicts through real Jira mappers, proven by held-out test with both forms and existing adopt seeding test

Pre-A3 code must accept the new scalar storage format without behavioral change, verified by running both normalized and raw baselines through pre-A3 live comparison code and requiring zero mutation deltas

All three assignee identity forms (email, accountId, displayName) must remain in the baseline dict unchanged and preserve inbound-direction suppression across both forward and rollback corpus comparison

Corpus benchmark must show at least 50% serialized-size reduction measured across all stored baselines with zero forward mutation deltas, zero rollback mutation deltas, and zero assignee value/shape deltas
